gridDNA: A vertical stack of distinct content blocks: a two-line headline, a horizontal product comparison section with associated badges and a connector, a two-line offer statement, and a bottom call-to-action band with fine print. The background is a solid color with a contrasting bottom band.

typeScale: headline (red) ~6% of canvas height, headline (black) ~5%, offer (green) ~8%, subheadline/cta ~3%, fine print ~1.5%
colourBlocking: Top 80% light grey solid background, bottom 20% bright green solid background band.
negativeSpace: Ample negative space around the headline and between the product groups, allowing each element to stand out clearly and preventing visual clutter, especially around the main offer text.
eyePath: Headline (red) -> Offer (green text) -> Product Group 2 (5 Free) -> Product Group 1 (Buy 3) -> CTA Text.
whyItWins: The clear visual comparison of product quantities combined with a highly contrasting, oversized offer statement immediately communicates value and urgency.
